book.name: 1 TESALONAIKA
book.title: ME TESALONAIKA ꞌIDI LETA ꞌEBWEUNA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Yaubada nuwanuwana bubuna boboꞌana

Gosemao, ꞌebweu wate yage ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu manuna ꞌaemataluwemi, be ꞌaguguyemi, nate lowa bubuna nidi ꞌaeꞌitemi ga wamwalatonidi ꞌaene boboꞌadi, ta manudi Yaubada ꞌigwausowala, ga gete tuga niꞌatu ꞌediya wabuubuna, ta ꞌilobwenena be waguinuwa limalimadi.
Ta wate ꞌInapwana Yesu ꞌina loinao nidi ꞌaꞌebwaꞌemiya wamwalamwalatonidi.
Yaubada nuwanuwana ꞌimi miya ꞌesasena, ta geyaꞌabo waloeloelata,
be ꞌenega ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna wada ai ma imi bubuna boboꞌana ta palupaluna,
ta geyaꞌabo ma imi yalakwaiya, nadigega tomotai nidi Yaubada ꞌana toemwagemwageyao.
ꞌEnega wate geyaꞌabo mali tomota mwanediyao waꞌipwaꞌipwalidi, ꞌabona nai ꞌInapwana ꞌina gamwasowala waloba. Yage nidi manudi lowa ꞌaemataluwemi.
Manuna Yaubada ꞌiesinuweda nigeya bubuna baibailidi manudi, ta ꞌesasedi esi manudi.

ꞌEnega ꞌabo yaita loina nina ꞌileꞌoai, nigeya ꞌaene tomota ꞌidi loina, ta esi Yaubada ꞌina loina ꞌileꞌoaleꞌoa, manuna Yaluyaluwa Tabuna tauna nuwanuwa ꞌana togieꞌesasa, nate Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebwaya ꞌedaya.
Ta gosedao ꞌadi oboboma manuna geyaꞌabo ꞌaꞌetoꞌetoladiwa, manuna Yaubada tauna niꞌatu ꞌieꞌitemi be taumimo wada eoboobobomemi.
Nadigega wate tomota maiboꞌadi sena Masidonia solanaya waobobomedi. ꞌEnega ꞌada loꞌaetuetunemi be ꞌimi oboboma nina ꞌena wada ewaiwai,
be wate wada too be wada miyasiwalowa be taumimo ꞌimi paisewa wada paisewadi, be geyaꞌabo mali tomota ꞌalodi waꞌeꞌenuwadi, nadigega lowa ꞌaemataluwaꞌesemi.
Gete ꞌenega taudi nigeya Keliso ꞌana toemisao sida ꞌamayabemi. Ta ꞌomi ꞌami lema manuna geyaꞌabo mali tomota ꞌediya watuituila.
ꞌInapwana ꞌina ilalimanama manuna
Gosemao geyaꞌabo waemwagemwage tokwaiyao manudi, be ꞌenega ꞌabo yaita tasidai ꞌikwakwaiya, geyaꞌabo wanuwanuwa mwau, ꞌatuwa taudi nigeya ꞌidi emisamo toololimana manuna.
Ta ꞌaboꞌada Yesu taemisena ꞌaene mwawasega ꞌitoolo limana, ga nadigega wate taemisa ꞌaene gosedao nidi niꞌatu sikwaiya Yaubada ꞌida ila limanedima, Yesu maꞌenao.
Gete ꞌida ꞌInapwana ꞌina ona ꞌasimasimane ꞌemiya, ꞌaene tuta nina ꞌiila limanama, taudi kwaikwaiyidi Keliso sida gimi lobai, ta ꞌaboꞌada mayawasida muliyega.

Manuna ꞌInapwana nina maꞌenana sinabwana ꞌida apwesa, ta aniloseyao ꞌadi toanugana wate ꞌida bwau, ta wate yoguli simuꞌe sinabwana, be ꞌenega ꞌInapwana galewega ꞌimwaꞌutama, be tokwaiya nidi lowa Keliso ꞌana toemisao sida gimitoolo,
ta ꞌenega ꞌaboꞌada wate mayawasida maꞌedao tatutuꞌe galewaya, be ꞌida ꞌInapwana maꞌeda taelobaloba pwana ꞌediya, be tauna maꞌedai tada miyaataya.
ꞌEnega tetela gete ꞌenega wada giegwausowalimi.
